title: Habitats and Adaptations
summary: Why camels, snow leopards, fish and macaques look the way they do: features that help living things survive where they live.

ib.note: Natural selection explains adaptations in MYP 5 / DP

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 2: Diversity in the Living World

objectives: I can describe how organisms are adapted to their habitats.
I can explain how specific features help an organism survive.
I can predict the effect of habitat changes on organisms.
misconceptions: Animals choose to adapt during their lifetime.
All animals can live anywhere if they try.
Adaptations are only about the body, not behaviour.
